findings.fixForward2CoverageGap: The Level C2 service test registered normalized exports directly and did not traverse the real upload endpoint to a new worker process.
findings.rootCause: The real /datasets/upload route retains normalized source exports in the Phase2 process-local runtime. Planner persists a placeholder SQL dataset, but its normalizedExports are absent, so a fresh durable worker cannot reconstruct the canonical source object store from PostgreSQL/MinIO.
